title: Career Choices Quiz
description: Answer 10 quick questions. Choose the option that sounds most appealing to you. Your answers help identify career areas to explore.

questions.question: Which activity would you most enjoy?

choices.text: Designing an app, website, or product
Helping someone solve a personal or health challenge
Building or repairing something hands-on
Planning a project or organizing a team

questions.question: What kind of problem do you like working on?

choices.text: Finding patterns in information or data
Understanding what people need and how to support them
Figuring out how a machine, system, or structure works
Finding a creative way to communicate an idea

questions.question: Which work setting appeals to you most?

choices.text: A collaborative office or remote team
A school, clinic, or community organization
A workshop, construction site, or outdoor location
A studio, newsroom, or performance space

questions.question: What would you most like to learn?

choices.text: Programming, cybersecurity, or data analysis
Teaching, counseling, or patient care
Electricity, mechanics, or sustainable construction
Writing, visual design, or digital storytelling

questions.question: Which contribution would make you feel most satisfied?

choices.text: Creating a useful tool or improving a system
Making a meaningful difference in someone's life
Making or fixing something people can rely on
Sharing an original idea with an audience

questions.question: How do you prefer to approach a new task?

choices.text: Research it, analyze the details, and test ideas
Talk with people and understand their perspectives
Try it hands-on and learn by doing
Brainstorm several possibilities and shape a fresh solution

questions.question: Which local issue would you most want to help solve?

choices.text: Air, water, or land quality
Health and wellness in your community
Better roads, buildings, or public spaces
Access to learning and books for children

questions.question: Which class would you look forward to most?

choices.text: Biology or chemistry lab
Computer science
Drafting, engineering, or shop
Art, music, or creative writing

questions.question: When you work on a team, what role do you naturally take?

choices.text: Leading and planning the work
Collecting and checking the data
Explaining ideas to other people
Building the prototype

questions.question: How do you feel about spending time outdoors?

choices.text: I love it, especially fieldwork with a clear purpose
Sometimes, if it helps people
I prefer working indoors with screens
I prefer studios or stages

resultsNote: Count the career areas associated with your selected choices. Treat the most frequent areas as starting points for further exploration, not as a definitive career recommendation.
